description.value: MR MIKES is a Canadian SteakhouseCasual chain founded in 1960, serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and salads in a relaxed, no-dress-code environment. The Salmon Arm location sits on Lakeshore Drive West and welcomes walk-ins, with reservations recommended for weekends. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down meal and takeout ordering available, with delivery also on offer.

address.value: 1035 Lakeshore Drive West, Salmon Arm, British Columbia, V1E 1E4, Canada
